Generate a complete OpenFOAM case directory structure for a 2D lid-driven cavity flow simulation using icoFoam (transient, incompressible, single-phase Newtonian).
Create the following files: constant/transportProperties, system/blockMeshDict, system/controlDict, system/fvSchemes, system/fvSolution, 0/U, 0/p.
Geometry: a square cavity of 0.1 m by 0.1 m in the x-y plane, extruded 0.01 m in the z-direction.
Vertices: (0 0 0), (0.1 0 0), (0.1 0.1 0), (0 0.1 0).
Mesh: single hex block, 20 divisions in x, 20 divisions in y, 1 division in z (cell size 0.005 m x 0.005 m x 0.01 m), uniform (no grading).
Boundary names and types: "movingWall" (top, y=0.1) with no-slip moving, "fixedWalls" (bottom, left, right) with no-slip stationary, "frontAndBack" (z-faces) with empty boundary condition.
In constant/transportProperties set nu (kinematic viscosity) to 0.001 [m2/s].
In 0/U set internalField to uniform (0 0 0). Set movingWall to fixedValue (1 0 0). Set fixedWalls to fixedValue (0 0 0). Set frontAndBack to empty.
In 0/p set internalField to uniform 0. Set movingWall and fixedWalls to zeroGradient. Set frontAndBack to empty.
In system/blockMeshDict define a single block with the four vertices above in the z=0 plane, extruded 0.01 m in z, with nCells 20 20 1, and map the boundary patches to the named boundary conditions described above.
In system/controlDict set application icoFoam, startFrom startTime, startTime 0, endTime 0.5, deltaT 0.002, writeControl timeStep, writeInterval 20, writeFormat ascii, runTimeModifiable true, libraryPathList with OpenFOAM standard libs, libs (libsSimpleFoam and libsIncompressibleTransportModels).
In system/fvSchemes set ddt(U) to Euler, div(phi,U) to Gauss linearUpwind grad(U), div(phi,p) to Gauss linear, grad(U) to Gauss linear, grad(p) to Gauss linear, laplacian(nu,U) to Gauss linear, snGrad to Gauss linear, interpolationSchemes to linear.
In system/fvSolution set relaxationFactors with U at 0.8 and p at 0.4 (or none if unrelaxed icoFoam). Set solver for p to PCG with preconditioner DIC and tolerance 1e-08 and maxIter 1000. Set solver for U to PBiCGStab with preconditioner DILU and tolerance 1e-08 and maxIter 1000.
The top wall moves in the +x direction at a constant velocity of 1 m/s, meaning the Reynolds number implied is Re = U*L/nu = 1*0.1/0.001 = 100.
